# Files that can run code on a maintainer's machine or in CI, or that change
# what the security checks see. A pull request that adds, changes or deletes
# any of them needs an APPROVED review from a maintainer on its latest commit
# before the `security` check passes. Globs follow .gitignore rules: `**`
# spans directories, and a pattern without a slash matches at any depth.
# Keep .github/CODEOWNERS in step with this list.

# CI, repository settings, and the security checks themselves
.github/**
scripts/**

# Git hooks and editor or container tooling that runs on checkout or open
lefthook.yml
lefthook-local.yml
.lefthook/**
.husky/**
.vscode/**
.devcontainer/**
.idea/**
.envrc
.gitattributes
.gitmodules
.semgrepignore
